god_mode.setting: A misty mountain pass at dawn

cons: Risk of being spotted if you stumble on loose shale
Closing the distance puts you in melee range
choices.description: Utilize the heavy mist and your training in Stealth to get a better look at the source of the noise.

cons: Mist provides the target with half-cover
The target might slip away into the fog
choices.description: Stay at a distance and ready your longbow, waiting for the figure to emerge from the mist.
pros: Ready for an immediate ranged attack

choices.description: Demand the figure show themselves, revealing your presence but potentially avoiding a fight.

planning_block.context: Kira has detected a hidden creature behind an outcrop in the mist.
planning_block.thinking: Kira (Lvl 1) has successfully detected a presence ahead. The sound of iron suggests a weapon or armor, and the guttural voice points toward something less than human—perhaps a goblin or a lone bandit. The mist provides excellent cover for a stealthy approach, but the terrain is treacherous.

spells_known.description: You choose a creature you can see within range and mark it as your quarry. You deal an extra 1d6 damage to the target whenever you hit it with a weapon attack, and you have advantage on Perception or Survival checks to find it.
spells_known.name: Hunter's Mark

spells_known.description: You touch a creature and increase its walking speed by 10 feet for 1 hour, allowing for faster travel and easier maneuvering through difficult terrain.
spells_known.name: Longstrider

spells_known.description: You create a 20-foot-radius sphere of fog centered on a point within range. The sphere heavily obscures the area, allowing a scout to vanish from sight or create a distraction for an escape.
spells_known.name: Fog Cloud
